## How it was tested

## Checklist

- [ ] The diff is as small as it can be
- [ ] A bug fix comes with the test that failed before it
- [ ] A changeset is added if package consumers would notice the change
- [ ] Docs and stories updated; the generated API block is current (`pnpm docs:gen`)
